brand.character: The A-OK ape: black fur, warm tan face, eyes wide open, a round surprised 'O' mouth, a red-and-white baseball cap printed 'A-OK', red over-ear headphones. Often wears a red hoodie printed 'APES ON KEYS'.
brand.style: Bold screen-print poster art: flat colour, confident thick black linework, subtle halftone and paper texture, WPA / propaganda-poster energy. Graphic, not photographic, not 3D-rendered.
brand.palette: Signal red #C8161D, ink black #0B0B0C, bone cream #F1E8D6. At most one small accent colour.
brand.voice: Dry, specific AI-culture satire. In on its own joke.
brand.rules: No real people or likenesses. No third-party logos or trademarks. No partisan politics. The ape does not smoke or drink. Must read clearly as a 300px thumbnail. Square format.

monkeys.title: CONTEXT WINDOW WASHER
monkeys.scene: The A-OK ape on a window-washer's suspended platform, squeegeeing one pane of an enormous chat window (message bubbles, a blinking cursor) high on a building. Heroic low angle, sunburst rays behind, propaganda-poster composition.

monkeys.title: RATE-LIMITED
monkeys.slogan: PLEASE HOLD. YOUR APE IS IMPORTANT TO US.
monkeys.scene: 8-bit pixel-art arcade screen: the A-OK ape at the back of a long queue of identical apes, holding a paper ticket numbered 429. A retro 'NOW SERVING: 001' sign above. Limited palette pixel art, visible chunky pixels.

monkeys.title: CERTIFIED A-OK
monkeys.scene: An official certification seal / rubber-stamp badge: the A-OK ape's head centred in a circular seal with a starburst edge, arc text around the rim, like a quality-inspection stamp on a document.
